item.title: Federal government investigates Vermont’s abortion coverage mandate
item.description: The Vermont Department of Financial Regulation has 20 days to respond to the federal inquiry, which singles out a state requirement that insurers offer abortion coverage. Read the story on VTDigger here: Federal government investigates Vermont’s abortion coverage mandate.

item.title: Rodolphe (Rod) James Vallee
item.description: It was Rod’s love of the outdoors that truly defined him. His degree in Wildlife Ecology from UVM anchored a lifetime of outdoor exploration, primarily with his camera. Upon his retirement, Rod and Betty traveled the world, cameras at the ready. Read the story on VTDigger here: Rodolphe (Rod) James Vallee.

item.title: Bove brothers plan to renovate Winooski apartments with tumultuous history
item.description: Rick and Mark Bove have shuffled through multiple plans for the 300 Main Street site, which attracted public concern because it was home to refugees and low-income families. The brothers now say they’ll soon begin a full renovation of the property, without adding units. Read the story on VTDigger here: Bove brothers plan to renovate Winooski apartments with tumultuous history .

item.title: Vermont’s high court weighs pulling law license of Addison County State’s Attorney
item.description: The hearing Thursday follows Eva Vekos’ conviction last year for drunken driving and accusations that she sought special treatment from officers in that case. Her lawyer argued the suspension would be too severe and too soon. Read the story on VTDigger here: Vermont’s high court weighs pulling law license of Addison County State’s Attorney.
